data.name: Starbreaker
data.detailed_description:
The belt is rich. The belt is dangerous. Break it open.

(Please note: Screenshots are considered Work In Progress at this time, and will be updated as the game develops)

Starbreaker is an open-world space sandbox about making your fortune at the edge of civilized space. Fly deep into procedurally generated asteroid fields wrapped around ringed planets and burning stars, crack rocks open with your mining laser, and haul the ore back through pirate-infested sectors. Bring a friend (or a few!) in online co-op!

MINE

Every asteroid is real, fully voxel based, minable rock. Scan the belt for glowing veins of Iron, Copper, Titanium, Platinum and rarer finds (such as the mysterious Vyrexium ore), then carve the ore out and watch the rock break apart under your beam. Sell your cargo at stations, upgrade your ship, and push into denser, richer, more dangerous fields.

FIGHT

You are not alone out here. Pirates prowl the profitable sectors, and every system has a danger rating - the deeper you go, the better the ore and the worse the company. Swap between plasma bolts, heavy cannons, missiles, and decoys on the fly, trigger Overdrive when things get desperate, and become a bounty hunter by hunting wanted bounties for some serious cash!

EXPLORE

A procedurally generated galaxy of star systems, ringed gas giants, moons, and stations - every world infinite, random, and persistent. Chart new systems, chase sensor contacts and mysterious frequencies/transmissions to derelict ships, hidden supply caches, and other mysterious, abandoned, or dangerous endeavors! Discovery pays: charting the unknowns of an infinite universe is a career of its own.

TOGETHER

Flip a switch and any of your worlds becomes an online co-op session. Prospect the same persistent belt with friends, watch each other's backs when the pirates show up, and split the fortune!

FEATURES

  • Open-world mining: real, fully voxel based, deformable asteroids with visible ore veins based on ore color

  • Ship combat: plasma guns, cannons, missiles, decoys

  • Bounty hunting: randomized, procedurally generated bounties with scaling risk and reward

  • Procedural galaxy: persistent seeded, infinite, randomly generated worlds, sector danger ratings, world discovery rewards

  • Points of interest: derelict ships, supply caches, and stranger things on sensors and through radio transmissions

  • Online co-op: per-world multiplayer toggle (with password support)

  • Modern rendering: Bake your graphics card in an infinite galaxy with Ray Traced Lighting, Global Illumination, Reflections, Refractions, Ambient Occlusion, and more! (Ray Tracing is optional, and you still have beautiful graphics in DirectX12 without Ray Tracing enabled)

  • 3D positional and realistic(ish) audio powered by FMOD

  • Built-in photo mode for capturing your best finds (inspired by NVIDIA's Ansel, built into the Vyrex Engine specifically for Starbreaker)

  • Fully customizable controls (in theory, you could even play with 1 finger...maybe?)

EARLY ACCESS, HONESTLY

The core game - mine, fight, sell, upgrade, explore, & co-op, is playable today, and it's what you're buying. On-foot astronauts and block based base/station & ship building are planned, and planet gameplay is extremely limited (you can orbit planets, and planets have a small safe zone around them at this moment in time). If you want the finished thing, wishlist and wait; if you want to shape it, welcome aboard, Starbreaker! 

Your purchase entitles you to receive all future updates free of charge!

data.short_description: Prospect a procedurally generated, infinite galaxy in this open-world space mining and combat sandbox. Carve ore from fully voxel based asteroids, outfit your ship, hunt bounties, and build your fortune! You can even bring a friend, or a few, in online (or LAN, up to you!) co-op/multiplayer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad core 3 GHz CPU / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Core i5-8600k
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or Equiv. (without Ray Tracing)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Dodeca core 3-4 GHz CPU / AMD Ryzen 9 3900X / Intel Core i9-9900k
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or Equiv. (with Medium Ray Tracing)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Fedora/Bazzite 44 or Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
  • Processor: Quad core 3 GHz CPU / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Core i5-8600k
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / Intel Arc A580 (without Ray Tracing)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: FMOD compatible sound card
